messages:
alex: Heads-up — noticed small tenants are getting token counts attributed to the wrong route when the request hits the subsecond priority lanes. Invoice preview shows spikes.
maya: Hmm. Is this after the routing-priority rollout yesterday?
sam: Can you paste a quick example of the raw events? wondering if enrichment is racing with routing.
alex: Pasting a tiny log snippet, redacted tenant ids:
```
2026-03-18T14:02:01.123Z INFO request=Rq123 route=fast-lane tenant=org-abc tokens=54
2026-03-18T14:02:01.124Z DEBUG enrichment started for Rq123
2026-03-18T14:02:01.125Z INFO routed to slow-fallback route=stable-lane
2026-03-18T14:02:01.126Z INFO billing-event emitted tenant=org-def tokens=54 request_id=Rq123
```
alex: So the request was routed to stable-lane but billing emitted with org-def in the downstream because enrichment completed after billing emit.
liam: Oof. That explains invoice-preview deltas for customers on reserved capacity.
julie: Is this only when routing latency <1ms? sounds like a race between route decision and tenant enrichment.
maya: Right — our async enrichment (to avoid adding p50 CPU) sometimes completes after the meter emits when we optimistic-route to fast-lane. We assumed fallback would reconcile but billing pipeline expects tenant id on emit.
sam: Two quick options: 1) stall emit until enrichment completes (adds tail latency), 2) emit with provisional token (provisional flag + ownerless ledger) and reconcile in postproc.
liam: Stall isn't great for subsecond tiers; customers expect consistent p50. Provisional tokens will complicate invoices unless reconciliation is robust.
julie: Could we shadow the provisional approach in canary? run for 5% of traffic, compare invoice diffs.
oncall-bot: ALERT: invoice-preview delta monitor triggered for 5 tenants in eu-prod at 14:03 UTC :warning:
alex: I like shadowing. Also propose adding a deterministic attribution key to requests (e.g., attribution_id = hash(route+session+reqid)) so dedupe/reconciliation is easier.
maya: attribution_id sounds good. But we need to ensure every component preserves it — edge, proxy, router, meter.
sam: Implementation sketch: meter emits billing events with attributes {attribution_id, provisional:true|false, original_route}. Reconciler consumes late enrichments and emits correction events with correction=true.
liam: For console UX we should mark invoice-preview lines with "provisional" and show corrections so users aren't surprised.
julie: I'll draft a short rollout plan: 1) add attribution_id + provisional flag (canary 2 weeks), 2) shadow reconciliation for 2 days, 3) enable provisional-to-final path after signoff. Assign INF-4321 for tracking.
alex: Added INF-4321. @maya @sam can you own the infra changes? @liam can you own console labeling? julie will coordinate rollout notes.
maya: Taking infra. I'll add a tiny feature flag at the router to toggle provisional emits.
sam: Taking reconciler and billing-event schema changes. will add idempotency token too.
liam: Will update console mockups and tooltip copy. quick question: do we want to surface provisional tokens in tenant billing-export CSV?
julie: Yes but behind a flag initially; customers can opt-in to see provisional drafts.
alex: Great. Let's keep the canary small. If invoice diffs > 0.1% we'll rollback the router flag. Thanks all :thumbsup:
